name: nonce0
description: Find out which of your keys a quantum computer would break, before it exists. Cross-chain public-key exposure scanner for EVM protocols.

scripts.smoke: npm pack --silent && D=$(mktemp -d) && tar xzf nonce0-*.tgz -C $D && cp -r test/fixtures $D/fixtures && node $D/package/bin/nonce0.js scan $D/fixtures --json; rm -rf $D nonce0-*.tgz
scripts.test:all: npm test && npm --prefix packages/protocol-types test && npm --prefix packages/pq-wallet test && npm --prefix packages/ring-client test && npm --prefix graph test && npm --prefix backend test && npm --prefix frontend test
scripts.typecheck:all: npm --prefix packages/protocol-types run typecheck && npm --prefix packages/pq-wallet run typecheck && npm --prefix packages/ring-client run typecheck && npm --prefix graph run typecheck && npm --prefix backend run typecheck && npm --prefix frontend run typecheck
